'''Specimen Gamma 19''' was a bio-engineered [[jurgoran]] that was kept aboard the ''[[Theoretika]]'', a [[research vessel]] operated by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. About one century before [[3639 BBY]], an accident happened. The specimen consumed [[Orgglo]], a researcher stationed aboard the ''Theoretika'', down to the marrow of his [[Bone/Legends|bones]]. This prompted Vipp, the science officer aboard the vessel, to place the creature in suspended animation. In [[3639 BBY]], various individuals who sought to recover the only remaining schematics for the [[HK-51 series assassin droid]] woke up the specimen and slew it.
